title: FCL vs LCL — How to decide? | MB Fret Services
description: Choosing between FCL and LCL in B2B sea freight: 13–15 m³ thresholds, safety, transit times, costs. Decision method and use cases on France–China/Turkey/Africa routes.
hero_intro: Optimize total cost, safety and time-to-market. A clear method to arbitrate based on your volume, lead times and cargo sensitivity.

faq.q: Which volume threshold justifies switching from LCL to FCL?
faq.a: In practice, around 13–15 m³, FCL often becomes more attractive economically and in terms of security. The decision still depends on port, seasonality and lead-time constraints.
Groupage implies additional handling. Export-grade packaging and ad valorem insurance significantly reduce risk. For sensitive/high-value cargo, FCL remains recommended.

faq.q: Can we mix LCL and air freight to speed up part of the flow?
faq.a: Yes, multimodality is a useful lever to meet critical milestones. We calibrate a suitable transport plan with partial consolidation.

cta_compare_desc: Our experts recommend an option based on your volume, risk profile and lead times.
